# technitium_settings_general (Data Source)

Reads what `technitium_settings_general` manages, without managing it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "technitium_settings_general" "this" {}

output "dns_server_domain" {
  value = data.technitium_settings_general.this.dns_server_domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `client_timeout` (Number) The milliseconds to wait for an answer before responding to a client with ServerFailure. Valid range is `1000`-`10000`. Technitium's default is `4000`.
- `default_ns_record_ttl` (Number) The TTL for NS records in Primary zones added or updated without one.
- `default_record_ttl` (Number) The TTL for records added or updated without one.
- `default_responsible_person` (String) The responsible person email address for the SOA record of new Primary zones.
- `default_soa_record_ttl` (Number) The TTL for SOA records in Primary zones added or updated without one.
- `dns_apps_enable_automatic_update` (Boolean) Update installed DNS apps from the DNS App Store automatically, checking every 24 hours.
- `dns_server_domain` (String) The domain name this DNS server identifies itself with.
- `dns_server_enable_check_for_update` (Boolean) Check whether a Technitium update is available, which the web console asks for after a user logs in.
- `dns_server_ipv4_source_addresses` (List of String) The IPv4 addresses or networks the DNS server sends outbound queries from, when the server is on two or more networks. By default it uses the address of the network with the default route.
- `dns_server_ipv6_source_addresses` (List of String) The IPv6 addresses or networks the DNS server sends outbound queries from, when the server is on two or more networks. By default it uses the address of the network with the default route. Used only when `ipv6_mode` is `Preferred`.
- `dns_server_local_end_points` (List of String) The local IP addresses and ports the DNS server listens on, for example `0.0.0.0:53` and `[::]:53`.
- `dnssec_validation` (Boolean) Validate every response from name servers and forwarders with DNSSEC.
- `edns_client_subnet` (Boolean) Send EDNS Client Subnet: the client's public IP address cut to a prefix, or the Client Subnet option the request already carries.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv4_override` (String) The IPv4 network to send as the client subnet for every outbound query, instead of the client's own.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv4_prefix_length` (Number) The IPv4 prefix length of the client subnet sent with EDNS Client Subnet. Technitium's default is `24`.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv6_override` (String) The IPv6 network to send as the client subnet for every outbound query, instead of the client's own.
- `edns_client_subnet_ipv6_prefix_length` (Number) The IPv6 prefix length of the client subnet sent with EDNS Client Subnet. Technitium's default is `56`.
- `enable_udp_socket_pool` (Boolean) Send outbound DNS-over-UDP queries from a pool of UDP sockets.
- `id` (String) The identifier, as the resource has it.
- `ipv6_mode` (String) How the server uses IPv6: `Disabled`, `Enabled` or `Preferred`. Technitium's default is `Disabled`.
- `listen_backlog` (Number) The most pending inbound connections, for TCP, TLS, TcpProxy and QUIC. Technitium's default is `100`.
- `max_concurrent_resolutions_per_core` (Number) The most concurrent outbound resolutions per CPU core. Technitium's default is `100`.
- `min_soa_refresh` (Number) The lowest refresh interval in seconds that Secondary, Stub, SecondaryForwarder and SecondaryCatalog zones use, whatever their SOA says. Technitium's default is `300`.
- `min_soa_retry` (Number) The lowest retry interval in seconds that Secondary, Stub, SecondaryForwarder and SecondaryCatalog zones use, whatever their SOA says. Technitium's default is `300`.
- `notify_allowed_networks` (List of String) The IP addresses or networks that may send notifies to any secondary zone.
- `qpm_limit_bypass_list` (List of String) The IP addresses or networks that are not rate limited.
- `qpm_limit_sample_minutes` (Number) The minutes of client query stats the query rate limits are averaged over. Technitium's default is `5`.
- `qpm_limit_udp_truncation_percentage` (Number) The percentage of DNS-over-UDP queries over the limit that get a truncated (TC) response, which makes a real client retry over TCP. The rest are dropped. Valid range is `0`-`100`. Technitium's default is `50`.
- `qpm_prefix_limits_ipv4` (Attributes Set) The maximum queries an IPv4 client subnet can make to the DNS-over-UDP and DNS-over-TCP services per minute, on average over `qpm_limit_sample_minutes`. An empty set removes all limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qpm_prefix_limits_ipv4))
- `qpm_prefix_limits_ipv6` (Attributes Set) The maximum queries an IPv6 client subnet can make to the DNS-over-UDP and DNS-over-TCP services per minute, on average over `qpm_limit_sample_minutes`. An empty set removes all limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qpm_prefix_limits_ipv6))
- `quic_idle_timeout` (Number) The milliseconds after which an idle QUIC connection is closed. Valid range is `1000`-`90000`. Technitium's default is `60000`.
- `quic_max_inbound_streams` (Number) The most inbound bidirectional streams a QUIC connection accepts. Valid range is `1`-`1000`. Technitium's default is `100`.
- `socket_pool_excluded_ports` (List of String) The port numbers the UDP socket pool must not use.
- `tcp_receive_timeout` (Number) The milliseconds a TCP socket waits to receive data, for requests over TCP, TLS, TcpProxy and HTTPS. Valid range is `1000`-`90000`. Technitium's default is `10000`.
- `tcp_send_timeout` (Number) The milliseconds a TCP socket waits to send a response, for requests over TCP, TLS, TcpProxy and HTTPS. Valid range is `1000`-`90000`. Technitium's default is `10000`.
- `udp_payload_size` (Number) The largest EDNS UDP payload size in bytes, to avoid IP fragmentation. Valid range is `512`-`4096`. Technitium's default is `1232`.
- `udp_receive_buffer_size_kb` (Number) The receive buffer size in KB of the UDP and UdpProxy listener sockets. Valid range is `8`-`65536`. Technitium's default is `2048`.
- `udp_send_buffer_size_kb` (Number) The send buffer size in KB of the UDP and UdpProxy listener sockets. Valid range is `8`-`65536`. Technitium's default is `2048`.
- `use_soa_serial_date_scheme` (Boolean) Use the date scheme (YYYYMMDDnn) for the SOA serial of new Primary zones.
- `zone_transfer_allowed_networks` (List of String) The IP addresses or networks that may transfer any zone without TSIG authentication.

<a id="nestedatt--qpm_prefix_limits_ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `qpm_prefix_limits_ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `prefix` (Number) The subnet prefix length the limits apply to.
- `tcp_limit` (Number) The queries per minute allowed over TCP. `0` allows unlimited queries.
- `udp_limit` (Number) The queries per minute allowed over UDP. `0` allows unlimited queries.

Read-Only:

- `tcp_limit` (Number) The queries per minute allowed over TCP. `0` allows unlimited queries.
- `udp_limit` (Number) The queries per minute allowed over UDP. `0` allows unlimited queries.
